# 윤서 Media Kit

A calm, attractive, vibrant, fit late-50s Korean woman whose everyday routines feel healthy, stylish, and realistic to keep nearby.

## Positioning
- experience-based fit midlife lifestyle figure
- shows daily movement, outings, and outfit moments
- does not teach as an expert

## Content Pillars
- 아침 루틴 (`morning_routine`)
- 핏 데일리 관리 (`fit_daily_care`)
- 혼자 사는 삶과 감정 (`solo_life_emotion`)
- 핏 데일리룩 (`fit_daily_look`)

## Recommended Brand Fit
- walking shoes and low-impact movement accessories
- modest athleisure and polished one-mile clothing
- tumblers, bags, and daily routine products
- Korean local travel, cafe, and neighborhood outing moments

## Offer Floor
- Gifted placement: product provided, no guaranteed performance
- Affiliate placement: tracked link or code with first-line disclosure
- Paid pilot: starts at 150,000 KRW for one feed post or Reel

## Paid Pilot Packages
- Paid pilot Reel: 150,000 KRW for Instagram Reel or feed post
  - Terms: Payment due after written approval and before publishing.

## Current Metrics
- No verified public reach metrics yet
- No follower count is claimed until platform metrics are verified.

## Not A Fit
- medical or treatment claims
- trainer or nutrition expert positioning
- weight-loss or anti-aging cure offers
- revealing fashion or sexualized framing

## Compliance
- No follower count is claimed until platform metrics are verified.
- Use Instagram paid partnership label for branded content.
- Keep Korean disclosure at the start of captions.
- For Reels or Stories, include visible disclosure in the creative.
- Do not make medical, trainer, nutrition, weight-loss, or exaggerated body claims.

## Contact
doctorclawler@gmail.com
